why: Issue #597. A slot already bound to a pad Tanks cannot read shows that pad as its current source with no 'not supported' suffix, which is exactly how a working pad reads. The pad is present, so the disconnected suffix does not fire either. Killed by the assigned-unsupported-pad case. ANCHOR REPOINTED (issue #556): the controller label helpers moved from `createHud`'s closure to `src/game/controller-labels.ts`, taking the live pad list as a parameter instead of reading `currentDetectedPads` from scope. The mutation is unchanged in meaning; only where the line lives, and its indentation, moved. Re-pointed when the Controllers pane moved to `controllers-pane.ts` (issue #556). The body is unchanged; `currentDetectedPads` became the local `pads`, because the list is now the host's and reaches this renderer as a value rather than a closure read.
killedBy: hud: controller assignment panel (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-17-controller-assignment.md) a pad the browser reports but Tanks cannot read (issue #597) marks a slot whose ASSIGNED pad cannot be read, rather than showing it as working
